{{Quote|Jatz musician Fitz Roi ''[&hellip;]'' has once again managed to bring his concert tour to a blasting halt when his latest exploit resulted in immediate expulsion from Rimma, where he was due to perform in a concert the following morning.|A news report by TriNebulon News|<ref name="Journal3" />}}
'''Rimma''' was an astronomical object in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Recardeon]] was located on Rimma, as was a set of ancient ruins. Several scrolls discovered in the latter by [[3637 BBY]] noted the existence of the artifacts known as the [[Three Great Works]].

[[1 BBY/Legends|Four thousand years]] later, the [[Jatz/Legends|jatz]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Fitz Roi]] was set to perform on Rimma. However, on the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] before his [[Music/Legends|concert]], Roi caused an incident in the [[Crystal Room]] of the [[Teirra Parko]] establishment in which he fired his [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|projectile pistols]] at various historical artifacts kept in the room, causing damage to the artwork on display. Local officials immediately expelled Roi from Rimma, and the millions of the musician's fans engaged in [[riot]]s in Recardeon upon learning of the concert's cancellation.

Another instance of rioting on Rimma occurred at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when mobs of the residents of the [[Norsec shanty town]] entered the suburbs of Recardeon and looted the private residences located there. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the Rimma [[Star system/Legends|system]], [[Alyk Krysusten]], subsequently issued a public declaration in which he claimed the mobs had been incited by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] provocateurs, further stating that the government would take strict security measures as a result of the disorders.

==Description==
Rimma was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Two of the Three" /> located in the [[Rimma system/Legends|Rimma system]], a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA Rimma" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC Rimma" /> The Rimma [[Star system/Legends|system]] served as a [[Astrogation/Legends|navigational]] anchor point on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]<ref name="CSWE Rimma">{{CSWECite|III|101|Rimma}}</ref> [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> which connected it to the Core Worlds' [[Dentaal system/Legends|Dentaal system]] and the [[Giju system/Legends|Giju system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA Rimma" />

==History==
===The artifacts of Rimma===
{{Quote|Rimma officials were not amused when Roi, while patronizing the Teirra Parko, wildly shot his famous antique projectile pistols at random fixtures in the Crystal Room.|A news report by TriNebulon News|<ref name="Journal3" />}}
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
At some point by [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date SoR">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} &mdash; According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the majority of the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] take place in approximately [[3637 BBY]]. The Crew Skill mission "Two of the Three" is part of the ''Shadow of Revan'' expansion and therefore also takes place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> several scrolls were discovered in a set of ancient ruins on Rimma. The documents noted the existence of the artifacts known as the [[Three Great Works]]. By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], only two of the artifacts had been recovered, and<ref name="Two of the Three" /> the future [[Alliance Commander|commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]]<ref name="Commander">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=3}} establishes that [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]]&mdash;who becomes the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the future [[Eternal Alliance]] in "Chapter IX: The Alliance"&mdash;also was the player-controlled character in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''.</ref> sent a companion on a search for the third of the Great Works.<ref name="Two of the Three" />
{{Endgame}}

Around the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[1 BBY/Legends|35:1:22]], the famed [[Jatz/Legends|jatz]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Fitz Roi]] visited Rimma as part of his<ref name="Journal3" /> Core-wide [[Summerside Tour]] of [[Music/Legends|concerts]].<ref name="Journal4">{{JournalCite|4|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> Millions of fans of Roi's music flocked to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Recardeon]] on Rimma from all over the [[Star/Legends|star]] system. On the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] before he was to perform in a concert in Recardeon, Roi visited the [[Teirra Parko]] establishment, where another occupant of the [[Crystal Room]] issued a challenge to him. In response, the musician started firing his famous antique [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|projectile pistols]] at the Crystal Room's fixtures in a random, uncontrolled fashion. In the ensuing chaos, several historical artifacts were either destroyed or damaged.<ref name="Journal3" />

Rimma officials responded immediately and permanently deported Roi from the celestial body, bringing his concert tour to a halt. Roi's fans, upon learning of the concert's cancellation, engaged in [[riot]]ing, which caused several hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits']] worth of damage to properties in downtown Recardeon. On 35:1:22, [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]] covered the Crystal Room incident in a [[Media/Legends|news]] report issued from Recardeon.<ref name="Journal3" />

===Disorders in Recardeon===
{{Quote|Mobs of angry, desperate beggars surged into Recardeon's northern suburbs, looting private residences and several estates before reaching the industrial sector and stout resistance from corporate security troops.|A news report|<ref name="GCG" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alyk Krysusten]] served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the Rimma system.<ref name="CSWE Rimma" /> At some point during that conflict, the inhabitants of the [[Norsec shanty town]] started rioting, entering the suburbs of Recardeon and looting private residences there. Upon reaching the industrial sector of the city, the mobs encountered fierce resistance from [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] of corporate security.<ref name="GCG" />

In response to the disorders, Krysusten made a public declaration the following day. The governor claimed that his intelligence sources indicated the inhabitants of the Norsec shanty town had been incited to riot by [[Politics/Legends|political]] dissidents affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. According to Krysusten's declaration, the Rebel provocateurs were also living in the slum district, hiding among the huts of the locals while in the process of establishing a permanent base of operations. The governor ordered an increase in security checks throughout Recardeon and traffic restrictions from outlying areas of the city.<ref name="GCG" />

Later that day, Krysusten was scheduled to meet with [[Iolyn Travanne]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the local [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]], and the citizens of Recardeon expected that Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] would be ordered by the government to overrun the Norsec district in order to disperse its populace and eliminate any Rebel presence. The rioting in Recardeon and its aftermath was later reported on by media.<ref name="GCG" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|Several of Rimma's historical artistic artifacts on display in the Crystal Room were damaged or destroyed in the chaos, and officials moved quickly to deport Roi permanently from Rimma.|A news report by TriNebulon News|<ref name="Journal3" />}}
Rimma was the site of the city of Recardeon. It featured an industrial sector as well as suburbs located in the northern section. Private residences and several estates were located in the suburbs.<ref name="GCG" /> The establishment known as the Teirra Parko was also located in Recardeon, and it contained the Crystal Room. In the latter, several of Rimma's historical artifacts of artistic value were displayed.<ref name="Journal3" /> Outside of Recardeon's northern suburbs lay a large district known as the Norsec shanty town. Desperate and angry beggars lived in hovels in the slum district.<ref name="GCG" /> In addition, a set of ancient ruins<ref name="Two of the Three" /> and a garrison of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] were also located on Rimma.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rimma was first mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 3|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 3]], which was published in [[August]] [[1994]]. The feature was authored by [[Paul Sudlow]].<ref name="Journal3" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Rimma system, and therefore the celestial body Rimma, in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA Rimma" />
